content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for THSTI Semi-Skilled Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for THSTI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name for THSTI Recruitment 2026 is Semi-Skilled (Lab Attendant). This position is open for eligible candidates to apply through a walk-in interview process.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Semi-Skilled (Lab Attendant) in THSTI?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Semi-Skilled (Lab Attendant) post in Translational Health Science and Technology Institute. Interested candidates should check the official notification for details.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in date for THSTI Semi-Skilled (Lab Attendant) recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Semi-Skilled (Lab Attendant) post at THSTI is scheduled for 12 October 2026. Candidates must report on this date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the Semi-Skilled (Lab Attendant) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Semi-Skilled (Lab Attendant) post is 25 years. Candidates must ensure they meet this age criterion before attending the interview.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for the Semi-Skilled (Lab Attendant) position?
faq.answer: Candidates applying for the Semi-Skilled (Lab Attendant) position must have a B.Sc. degree with 1 year of working experience in a lab. This is a mandatory eligibility criterion.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Semi-Skilled (Lab Attendant) post at THSTI?
faq.answer: The salary for the Semi-Skilled (Lab Attendant) post at THSTI is Rs. 27540 Per Month. This is a contractual position with a fixed monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for THSTI Semi-Skilled (Lab Attendant) recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the THSTI Semi-Skilled (Lab Attendant) recruitment. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview free of cost.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the THSTI Semi-Skilled (Lab Attendant) post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the THSTI Semi-Skilled (Lab Attendant) post involves a Walk-in Interview. Candidates will be evaluated based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required for the THSTI walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates need to carry original documents, self-attested photocopies of ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates. Extra passport-size photographs might also be needed.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for the Semi-Skilled (Lab Attendant) post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Semi-Skilled (Lab Attendant) post is Faridabad, Haryana. THSTI is located in Faridabad, making it the primary work location for this contractual role.
